tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i las gzhung me tog phreng mdzes kyi dgongs don mdor bsdus pa nges don rnying po bzhugs so/ 184)srid pa 'di na 'gran zla kun bral ba'i/ grags pa'i dbyar rnga don mthun zhing kun tu/ cher gsal pad+ma thod phreng las gzhan su/ 'jig rten mgon mchog de zhabs spyi bos mchod/ de la 'dir sems can gyi khams la bde bar gshegs pa'i snying pos ye khyabs su 'jag mig gi srin bu yan chad kyi rgyud la mchis mod cing*/ de nyid mngos du byed pa la sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyang 'bras gsum gyi sgo nas chos kyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yang snyid rmad byung rdo rje theg pa'i 185)rgyud dang man ngag bsgrub thabs sogs rgyal ba'i phrin las rab 'byams las snang mod kyi/ khyad par mchog tu rgyal ba pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi thugs rje mi zad gter chen las byung ba'i zab chos mtshan dang bkod pa mtha' yas pa'i breg rnams las/ yang zab bla med dgongs pa 'dus pa'i chos skor zhes nyi zla ltar grang pa de nid man dag snying por gyur pa gang zag spros pa chung ba la mos pa rnams kyi don du mdzad pa'i rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa cha ba smar thag de'i bsgrub pa gsal 186)byed kyi nor bu/ de'i las byang me tog 'phreng mdzes dang bcas pa'i ma bu rnams las/ 'dir phrin las lam khyer bsdus pa me tog phreng mdzes kyi sgom rim mdo tsam ston par byed de/ de la spyir rgyud sde'i rim so sor skyed rim gyi gnad rnams kyang so sor gsungs mod kyang*/ 'di ni rgyud sde 'og ma las ches rmad du byung ba yo ga gsum gyi nyams len gyi skabs dang*/ de la yang*/ bkod pa chen po'i rgyud las/ sems yas pa la skyed pa ste/ sems bcud can la rdzogs pa nyid/ mchog gsang rab la rdzogs pa che/ zhes pa ltar/ gdul bya'i blo rigs so so'i don du 'dul thabs kyi chos kyang so sor gsungs shing*/

de'i phyir/ zhi khro sgyu 'phrul/ bka' brgyad yang phur la sogs mdor na tan+t+ra sde bco brgyad la gtogs pa'i sgom khog phal cher ni rgya chen ba skyed rim gtso bor ston pa'i skabs yin la/ 'di ni zab pa rdzogs 187)rims gtso bor ston pa lung a nu yo ga'i dgongs don yin phyir/ de ltar rgyud sde so so'i skabs thob shes pa gal che zhing*/ des na 'di la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi dang po la/ thun mong gi tshogs bsags pa'i las rim skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa sogs kyi skabs su ni/ rang lus tha mal pa'i bdun gyi nam mkhar tshogs zhing rnams spyan drangs nas bzhugs par mos la tshogs bsags de nas sngon 'gro bye brag pa gser skyems bgegs gtor sogs kyi skabs su ni so so'i brjod tshig ltar gyi bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs dang rta mgrin gyi bskyed rim dang ldan pas mi ma yin rnams la ci bsgo ba'i bka' nyan par bsam/ mtshams gcod kyi skabs su ni/ don dam par stong nyid mtshan ma thams cad bral phyir bdag gzhan phan gnod bsrung bya srung byed sogs kyi yul las 'das pa chos kyi dbyings mnyam par chen 188)po'i rtsal mdangs las/ rang nyid rgyu'i he ru ka rdo rje sems dpa' dmar po gcig tu gsal ba'i thugs srog hūm̐ las phyag mtshan gyi rig pa dang me spungs sogs 'phros pas stong 'og phyogs mtshams dkrig pa'i gur khang du gyur par mos/ phyi nang gi mchod gtor byin rlabs kyi/ rgyu'i he ru ka'i thugs ka nas raṃ yaṃ khaṃ dang oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'bru gsum sogs kyi 'phro 'dus ye shes kyi mchod rdzas sus byin gyis brlabs/ de nas dngos gzhi la/ ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum gyi dang po de bzhin nyid kyis ni bdag lus gdos bcas kyi mtshan 'dzin sogs phyi nang snod bcud a 'thas su 'dzin pa'i zhen pa sbyang phyir spros bral gyi klong du mnyam par bzhag

kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis don dam stong nyid kyi tshul ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba la snying rje bsgom zhing de dag chos nyid kyi dbyings su bsgral bar dam bca'/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni ngo bo 189)stong pa nyid las ma g.yos bzhin du rang rtsal sgyu ma lta bu'i cho 'phrul gyi rol pa las/ ngo bo ltar na rang gi shes rig rig don dam pa'i ye shes/ rang bzhin ltar na dpal kun bzang snang mtha'am rdo rje sems dpa' de nyid/ thugs rje'i rnams pa ltar na/ rgyu'i he ru ka dbu dang phyag zhabs cha lugs rnam 'gyur sogs mtha' yus shing bsam gyis mi khyab pa so so skye bo'i yul las 'das shing*/ sku che chung gi tshad kyang nam mkhas gar khyab ru khyab cing 'dul byed ma nges pa'i bdako pa grangs med pas gang la gang 'dul gyi rdzu 'phrul la mnga' brnyes pa cig tu mos/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i skabs su/ gzhung nyid nas gsungs pa'i tshig rnams ni nang gi 'byung bzhi'i byor sdud kyis pha ma'i mngal du rdo rje'i lus grub tshul dang bstun nas gsungs pa ste/ 'di'i bskyed tshul dang gnas tshul gyi rgyas bshad rnams 190)ni dgongs 'dus rang gi yang gsang thugs kyi bsgrub pa nyi zla kha sbyor gyi nang du gsungs pa der blta zhing*/ 'gag don ma ro bsdu na phung khams skye mched rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du ye nas lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul gsar snying gi rgyud sde mtha' dag nas gsungs pa ltar las/ khyad par 'di skabs su/ rang gi lus nyid gzhal yas khang gi rang bzhin ye nas yin la yin par ngo shes shes shing gsal 'debs pa tsam nas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa mchog tu 'gyur bar gsungs/ gdan skyes pa ni/ rang gi rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad po pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi tshul dang*/ rtogs na thabs shes ma gtogs na chags sdang gnyis po nyi zla'i gdan du lhun gyis grub cing*/ de dag kyang kha dog dbyibs su blos bcos shing bsgom pa lta bu ma yin par ye nas yin pa'i don shes shing dran pa kho

191)nas chog la/ de nas lha bskyed pa'i rim pa dngos ni/ rgyud sde gzhan rnams las skye gnas bzhi'i bag chags sbyong phyir mngon byang lnga dang cho ga gsum sogs spros bcas kyi bskyed tshul gsung yang*/ 'dir ni dbyings skye med/ mtha' bral gyi klong nas rigs pa ye shes 'gags med rang byung don gyi lha shar ba ma gtogs/ kun rdzob spro bsdu mtshan bcas kyi bskyed rim la rag ma lus pa'i phyir na/ shes rig gi ngo bo he ru ka de nyid rnam rol gyi cho 'phrul du dkyil 'khor kun gtso pad+ma badz+ra rtsal du lhun gyis grub cing*/ de nyid kyang ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i snang tshul lam/ ming du btags tshul tsam du yab yum 'khor sogs su phye ba nyid do/ don du ni snang stong dbyer med rig pa'i ngo bo nyid dang*/ de'i rtsal ma ngas rnam shes tshogs brgyad/ nye nyon nyi shu/ sems byung lnga bcu/ rtog tshogs brgyad khri bzhi 192)stong sogs su shar zhing*/ de dag ni rgyu sems can gyi dus na las dang nyon mongs pa'i rtogs tshogs/ lam rnal 'byor pa'i dus na nyams dang 'char sgo'i bye brag 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi dus su mkhyen brtse mdzad pa phrin las kyi breg nyid du 'gyur zhing*/ des na 'dir lha rnams kyang*/ gzhung nyid las/ sku mdog phyag mtshan rnams 'gyur du ma ste/ gcig tu nges che rol sna tshogs ston/ snang stong ma 'gags lhang nge lhan ner gsal/ zhes gsungs pa nyid kho na ltar shes par bya zhing*/ de nas spyan 'dren yang*/ phyi rol nas mi gcig pa zhig spyan drangs shing 'byon rgyu yod pa lta bu ma yin te/ ma dag 'khrul pa'i snang ba sbyong phyir lha so so'i mtshan dang bzhugs gnas sogs tha dad nas spyan 'dren pa'i tshig ngag nas brjod kyang*/ don du rang rigs byang chub sems kyi rol pa'i cho 'phrul snang srid kun la ma khyab pa med phyir/ rang shes rig 193)pa'i dam tshig ye shes gnyis su byar med so so ma yin tha mi dad du spyan drangs/

ye nas 'du 'bral med pa de ka'i don shes pa ni bzhug gsol/ de nyid la nges shes rnyed pa ni phyag 'tshal lo/ de nyid rang la 'khrul med rang dbang gyur ba ni dbang bskur de'i don las mi 'da' bar dam bca' ba ni rgyas btab/ snang srid kyi 'dod yon dbang po drug gi spyod yul du gyur pa'i bzang ngan thams cad ro mnyam chen por rol ba ni phyi mchod/ dug lnga dug gsum thams cad rang shar rang grol du spyod pa ni nang mchod/ chags sdang gi rtog pa mtha' dag dbyings rig dbyer med du la zla ba ni gsang mchod/ cir snang lam du lhongs pas snang srid bdud rtsir gyur pa ni smon mchod/ dngos 'dzin gyi rtogs pa 'bur 'joms su sgrol ba ni rak+ta'i mchod pa/ bde gsal mi rtog la sogs pa'i nyams myong la 'dzin chags med pa ni 194)gtor ma'i mchod pa ste/ de dag thams cad la phyi rol du dmigs rten dngos su bshams pa ni mtshan ma rdzas kyi mchod pa/ nang gi sha khrag drod dbugs la sogs rang lus kha rje dbang thang dang bcas pa ni nang rang byung lhun grub kyi mchod pa/ gsang ba gshis skye med/ gdangs 'gag med rtsal sna tshogs 'char ba mtha' dag ni don dam ye shes kyi mchod pa/ de dag thams cad kyang 'bul bya'i yul/ 'bul byed kyi gang zag 'bul rgyu'i rdzas dngos sogs so sor ma grub gcig tu yang ma bsdus ming dang mtshan ma'i tha snyad las 'das shing yid dpyod kyi blo'am rtag chad kyi yul dang bral ba de kho na nyid yang dag don gyi mchod pa'i mchog tu gyur pa'i don rig par bya zhing*/ bstod pa'i rim pa yang de bzhin du/ ye shes rig pa'i lha la bstod pas mnyes rgyu dang ma bstod pas mi mnyes rgyu sogs yod pa min rung*/ rang rig don dam 195)stong nyid kyi rol rtsal sgyu ma lta bu lha'i rnam par shar ba'i sku mdog phyag mtshan gyi mtshon byed don dang rtags su mthun pa dran pa'i ched du bstod cing*/

de nas 'dzab kyi rim pa yang*/ rang gi dbugs 'byung { hūm̐/ }'jug ( oṃ/ }gnas { āḥ/ }gsum snying po 'bru gsum du ye nas lhun gyis grub cing*/ de'i grangs chad kyang nyin zhag drug re la nyi khri chig stog drug brgyar rtag tu 'gyur ba de nyid rig tu nyams len pa ni 'di ka'i rang gzhung gi bsnyen pa'i mchog yin cing*/ mtshan ma spros bcas kyi 'dzab la spro na/ rang nyid dgongs pa 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥdamar gyi mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba las 'od 'phros pas rgyal ba rnams mchod cing thugs rje nus mthu bsdus/ 'gro ba'i las nyon dang sdug bsngal gsal bar dmigs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ badz+ra gu ru de wa ḍāk+ki ni/ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes zla ba ni las byang chen mo tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs kyi dgongs pa'o/ bar 'dir chos skyong bka' srung gi 196)rigs kyi gtor chog gang dang gang byed kyang*/ bdag bskyed lha'i rnal 'byor skyed rdzogs dbyer med med gong bzhin bsgom pa'i ngang nas/ chos skyong rnams kyang ngo bo rang rig gsal stong dbyer med kyi ngang las/ rnam rol gdug pa 'dul phyir chos skyongs so so'i skur snang ba sku mdog phyag mtshan rnam 'gyur cha lugs cir yang ston cing*/ mthu stobs drag 'tshal dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa/ 'khor tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab cing grangs med pas bskor ba rnams rang gi mdun du khrom tshogs pa ltar bzhugs pa la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi 'du 'phro las byung ba'i gang la ci 'dod kyi mchod gtor rgya chen phul bas mnyes shing tshim nas/ bdag gi ji ltar bcol ba'i phrin las thams cad thogs pa med par bsgrub par mos/ de nas tshogs 'khor yang*/ phyi ltar gling bzhi ri rab la sogs snod bcud thams cad tshogs kyi dngos por ye nas lhun gyis grub 197)pa dang*/ nang ltar lus srog longs spyod 'dod yon lnga sogs yo byad kun dang*/

gsang bar oṃ kyi 'du 'phro thams cad tshogs kyi dngos por ma gyur pa med la/ mtshan ma rdzas kyi tshogs ni 'byor na bza' btung gos rgyan sogs 'dod yon gyi dngos po ci 'byor thams cad bshams shing zag med ye shes kyi mchod par byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul/ ma 'byor na sa rdo chu sogs la'ang rung zhing*/ der ma zad snod kahayi 'jig rten tshogs gzhong du bcud kyi sems can tshogs rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa sogs mdor na thams cad ting nge 'dzin gyi byed las la rag las pa ma gtogs sha chang zan gyi yo byad tsam la tshogs kyi 'khor lo brjod pa dang ltos pa ni ma yin pas de lta bu'i gnad shes par bya/ bskul dang chad mod gtor skyong sogs kyang nang don kho na las ma 'das pa ni 'di skabs kyi khyad par ba'i dgongs pa 198)yin pa'i tshul ni gzhung nyid kyi tshig kho nas shes kyi/ kun rdzobs a 'thas su bon chog mdos gyer lta bu ni ma yin no/ rdzogs rim bsdu ba yang rnam 'gyur sna tshogs su snang ba thams cad rang las byung zhing rang la thim pa chu dang rlabs nam mkha' dang sprin gyi dpes rtogs par bya zhing ma bcos spros med du mnyam par bzhag la/ rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas gzhan don du sems bskyed rgya chen pos bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas btab par bya'o/ mdor na las gzhung 'di ni a nu dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med rdzogs pa'i rim pa gtso bor ston pa'i skabs yin pas rgyud sde 'og ma dang*/ ma hā yo ga sogs kyi rigs 'dre dang rgyas 'geb byed rgyu ni ma yin zhing*/ tshul 'di dag blor mi shong ba'i skye bo dag gis/ 'di ni 'thad do/ 'di ni mchungs so/ 'di ni mi mtshungs so/ zhes pa la sogs kyi rnam par rtog pa mang pos bslad 199)par byed pa ni skyed rdzogs bzung 'jug don dam pa'isnying po'i gnang gsang tshul bzhin du ma rtogs pa'i skyon kho nar zad la/

rnal 'byor dam pa rnams kyi blo ngor ni me tog phreng mdzes tsam du ma zad snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang byung rig pa'i klong du ma 'dus pa rdul phra rab tsam yang med pa ni rgyal ba kun gyi dgongs bzhed gcig tu mthun pa don mad pa'i bden pa'o/ 'di bris dge bas ma lus skye 'gro kun/ tha snyad tshig gi rdzun pas ma slad par/ yang dag nges don snying po mngon gyur te/ gdod ma'i klong du gtan srid zin par shog las byang me tog phreng mdzes kyi dgongs don mdor dril ba 'di nyid/ 'jags zhabs nas/ grub mchog tshe dbang don 'grub kyis bskul bar mdzad pa'i ngor/ sna tshogs rang grol gyis gnas chen dur khrod mgo dgu'i ri bo'i spor/ bla brang nor bu brtsegs pa'i yang thog tu bkod pa'o// 200)
